title: Hengliyuan Carton Packing Planner
short: Measured packs to a 3D carton plan
description: Plan single-SKU cartons or a mixed single-carton trial from measured packs, with interactive 3D and PDF.
features: Single-SKU uniform orientation grids, optional order cartons and final carton.
Mixed one-carton trial with unplaced counts; no order-level extrapolation.
Customer-selected orientation/layers, optional measured gross limit, 3D angle/layer/SKU views and company PDF.
limit: Rectangular-envelope heuristics do not prove global optimality, physical support, carton strength, safe handling, pallet or container suitability.
